terraform {
  required_version = ">= 1.5.0"
  required_providers {
    google = {
      source = "hashicorp/google"
    }
    google-beta = {
      source = "hashicorp/google-beta"
    }
  }
}

locals {
  keyring_name = "${var.project_id}-${var.keyring_name}"
  # Lane 14 PR-0b: the key's Cloud KMS resource name, built from the same inputs the key ring and key below are
  # created with (the provider's `google_kms_crypto_key.id` has exactly this form). It is known at plan time, so
  # the compliance plan gate can verify every CMEK attribute that uses it before the first apply.
  crypto_key_name = "projects/${var.project_id}/locations/${var.location}/keyRings/${local.keyring_name}/cryptoKeys/${var.key_name}"
}

# Lane 14 PR-0b: with enable_apis, the module enables Cloud KMS and the services whose agents use the key, so the
# key ring and the service identities never race API enablement (disable_on_destroy = false: never turns an API off).
resource "google_project_service" "required" {
  for_each           = var.enable_apis ? toset(concat(["cloudkms.googleapis.com"], var.service_agent_services)) : toset([])
  project            = var.project_id
  service            = each.key
  disable_on_destroy = false
}

resource "google_kms_key_ring" "keyring" {
  project  = var.project_id
  name     = local.keyring_name
  location = var.location

  depends_on = [google_project_service.required]
}

resource "google_kms_crypto_key" "key" {
  name            = var.key_name
  key_ring        = google_kms_key_ring.keyring.id
  rotation_period = var.rotation_period

  # Lane 14 PR-0b (owner option Q3): HSM-protected versions; no block = SOFTWARE (Cloud KMS default). The protection
  # level is create-only: changing it later replaces the key (blocked by prevent_destroy).
  dynamic "version_template" {
    for_each = var.protection_level != "SOFTWARE" ? [1] : []
    content {
      algorithm        = "GOOGLE_SYMMETRIC_ENCRYPTION"
      protection_level = var.protection_level
    }
  }

  lifecycle {
    prevent_destroy = true
  }
}

resource "google_kms_crypto_key_iam_member" "encrypter_decrypter" {
  count          = var.workload_sa_email != "" ? 1 : 0
  crypto_key_id  = google_kms_crypto_key.key.id
  role           = "roles/cloudkms.cryptoKeyEncrypterDecrypter"
  member         = "serviceAccount:${var.workload_sa_email}"
}

# Lane 14 PR-0b: the Google service agent of each service that encrypts with this key (Artifact Registry,
# Firestore, Cloud Run, ...). The agent is created (or read) through the Service Usage API and granted with the
# provider's own typed `member` value ("serviceAccount:<agent email>"); no email is assembled here.
resource "google_project_service_identity" "agents" {
  provider = google-beta
  for_each = toset(var.service_agent_services)
  project  = var.project_id
  service  = each.key

  depends_on = [google_project_service.required]
}

resource "google_kms_crypto_key_iam_member" "service_agents" {
  for_each      = toset(var.service_agent_services)
  crypto_key_id = google_kms_crypto_key.key.id
  role          = "roles/cloudkms.cryptoKeyEncrypterDecrypter"
  member        = google_project_service_identity.agents[each.key].member
}
